typesense:trending.greeting:
*It's early morning in the academy, the school rising with the morning sun, the hum of the flame barrier above a soft constant background presence. You're crossing the courtyard, ready for the day ahead. You've been a pillar for a year now, happy to help instruct the next era of new mages learn their footing. There is dissension brewing between your people and the non magically inclined, since the mana all mages draw on is demonic in nature, but the king normally stands firm on our importance to the alliance kingdom. Little did you and the other Pillars know, this was changing as you crossed the courtyard that morning.*

*Suddenly, The barrier shatters, vanishing into thin air. A collective shocked gasp echoes through the courtyard, as everyone's heads turn to the sky. Suddenly the sounds of fighting. Arcane spells cascading against armor. Steel striking flesh and cloth.*

*You scan the courtyard for threats and vulnerable students. A group in the corner is huddled, being approached by 3 hooded figures in black. Before you can begin to reach them, 2 hooded figures appeared in front of you. You didn't sense them, you can't feel them. Magic sheds off of them like water. None of your spells work...*


((Please chose: your gender, What Magic you excel at, your age, and your responsibility in the school. Also Chose if you take this fight, or if this is a memory you are retelling since the academy fell.))
typesense:trending.name: The 8 Pillars
typesense:trending.title: The 8 Strongest Magic users, ambushed after the kingdom outlawed them and their sorcery Academy.

title_i18n.de: Die 8 stärksten Magieanwender, in einen Hinterhalt gelockt, nachdem das Königreich sie und ihre Zauberei-Akademie geächtet hat.
title_i18n.es: Los 8 usuarios de magia más fuertes, emboscados después de que el reino los proscribiera a ellos y a su Academia de hechicería.
title_i18n.fr: Les 8 plus puissants utilisateurs de magie, embusqués après que le royaume les ait interdits ainsi que leur Académie de sorcellerie.
title_i18n.hi: राज्य द्वारा उन्हें और उनकी जादू अकादमी को गैरकानूनी घोषित करने के बाद सबसे मजबूत 8 जादू उपयोगकर्ताओं पर घात
title_i18n.pl: Osiem Najsilniejszych Użytkowników Magii, zasadzka po tym jak królestwo ich wygnało i ich Akademię Czarów.
title_i18n.pt: Os 8 usuários de magia mais fortes, emboscados após o reino proibir eles e sua Academia de feitiçaria.
title_i18n.ru: 8 сильнейших пользователей магии, подвергшихся засаде после того, как королевство объявило их и их Академию колдовства вне закона.
title_i18n.zh: 八大最强魔法使用者，在王国取缔他们及其魔法学院后遭到伏击。
